name: Cara Mund
desc: American beauty pageant winner, lawyer, Congressional candidate
summary: Cara D. Mund ( KAR-ə; born December 8, 1993) is an American attorney and former Miss America from Bismarck, North Dakota. In June 2017, she was crowned Miss North Dakota 2017. On September 10, 2017, she was crowned Miss America 2018 in Atlantic City and became the first contestant from North Dakota to win the competition.
